title: The same farm under other climates
intro: The weather component reads a file for one place. Running the same soil, crops and management with the weather of several places shows how much of the result belongs to the climate.

marks.d: Adds a further factor, grouped by Irrigation, Nitrogen and tillage, Weather and climate, Soil and crop, and Chemicals.
Every combination, one thing at a time, or the values paired in order.
The largest number of runs; a spread of the combinations is chosen when there are more.
The number of runs and the time they take on this computer.
Runs every combination, several at a time.
